plugin.description: Follow a named nearby player using terrain navigation and foreground WASD input.
hint: Select WASD movement in PoE2. {0} starts/stops; Escape stops. Foreground game only. Start in preview mode and inspect the route.
choose_leader: Select the leader from nearby players
no_players: No nearby players detected. Move into the same area as the leader.
clearance_hint: Prefer routes away from walls, but allow closer movement when starting beside a wall or passing through a narrow corridor.
limits: Follows a named visible player in the same area. Closed doors need manual opening. No portals or background dual-client input. Losing the target, focus or area stops following; press {0} to resume.
status.stopped: Stopped — {0} to start, Escape to stop
status.settings_open: Settings open — close settings, then press {0}
status.frame_gap: Rendering paused or delayed — press {0} to resume
status.unfocused: Game lost focus — press {0} to resume
status.game_state: Not in active gameplay — press {0} to resume
status.panel: Chat or panel open — close it, then press {0}
status.player_invalid: Player unavailable or dead — press {0} when ready
status.leader_name: Select the leader from the nearby-player list first
status.target_missing: Leader unavailable, dead, or outside visible range — press {0} to retry
status.target_changed: Target identity changed — press {0} to resume
status.terrain_missing: Terrain/position unavailable or target too far away
status.no_path: No walkable route — check doors and terrain obstacles
status.manual: Manual movement detected — press {0} to resume
status.stuck: No movement progress — stopped; press {0} to retry
